WITH quarantined AS (
    UPDATE automation.document_failure_events
    SET
        alert_status = 'delivery_unknown',
        last_error = 'Alert worker lease expired; delivery uncertain',
        lease_token = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL
    WHERE alert_status = 'processing'
      AND lease_expires_at <= NOW()
    RETURNING event_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*)::integer AS quarantined_count
FROM quarantined;

WITH selected AS (
    SELECT event_id
    FROM automation.document_failure_events
    WHERE alert_status = 'pending'
      AND alert_attempts < 5
    ORDER BY received_at, event_id
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    LIMIT 10
)
UPDATE automation.document_failure_events AS d
SET
    alert_status = 'processing',
    alert_attempts = d.alert_attempts + 1,
    lease_token = gen_random_uuid(),
    lease_expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '3 minutes'
FROM selected
WHERE d.event_id = selected.event_id
RETURNING
    d.event_id,
    d.organization_id,
    d.document_id,
    d.job_id,
    d.filename,
    d.error_message,
    d.occurred_at,
    d.lease_token,
    d.alert_attempts;

WITH finalized AS (
    UPDATE automation.document_failure_events
    SET
        alert_status = 'delivered',
        alerted_at = NOW(),
        lease_token = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL,
        last_error = NULL
    WHERE event_id = $1::uuid
      AND lease_token = $2::uuid
      AND alert_status = 'processing'
      AND lease_expires_at > NOW()
      AND $3::integer = 200
      AND NULLIF($4::text, '') IS NOT NULL
    RETURNING event_id
)
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM finalized) AS finalized;

WITH quarantined AS (
    UPDATE automation.document_failure_events
    SET
        alert_status = 'delivery_unknown',
        last_error = LEFT($3::text, 1000),
        lease_token = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL
    WHERE event_id = $1::uuid
      AND lease_token = $2::uuid
      AND alert_status = 'processing'
    RETURNING event_id
)
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM quarantined) AS quarantined;

WITH quarantined AS (
    UPDATE automation.document_failure_events
    SET
        alert_status = 'delivery_unknown',
        last_error = 'Discord accepted or outcome uncertain; finalization failed',
        lease_token = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL
    WHERE event_id = $1::uuid
      AND lease_token = $2::uuid
      AND alert_status = 'processing'
    RETURNING event_id
)
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM quarantined) AS quarantined;
